name: Runey
summary: All-in-one business app for freelancers and small studios: invoices, projects, clients, expenses and proposals.
description: Workspace for freelance businesses combining branded and recurring invoicing with online payments, project and task tracking with kanban boards and time tracking, a lightweight client CRM, multi-currency expense logging, revenue dashboards and interactive proposals.
contains: branded invoices, recurring billing and online payments
projects and tasks: kanban boards, time tracking, assignees
